text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Snacky snacks! ♪ Hey, Dia, what should our next challenge be?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hm… We've already tried the Habanero Hot Carrot Gummies and the Supersized 50cm Cleat Candies…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe, this place is a gold mine of strange goodies! I've never seen this stuff anywhere else. Where does the academy even get it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, look over there! They have Umamusume cookies!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I remember these. They have the letters of the alphabet on them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're right… Hehe, it's so nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It wasn't long after we became friends. These cookies were the first snack we shared in the park.

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text: A nice customer gave me these! Let's eat them together, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Snacks in my household are always served on a plate…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So to eat something straight out of the packaging for the first time made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, that really happened? You've got a really good memory.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I remember this part, at least! You took the cookies and spelled "Kita" with them!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Cool, guess we're having these today! The weather's great, so how about we take them outside?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! It'll be just like that time at the park.
